text: {Name} lost a dock job near {Place} and enlisted for regular wages. During years of army service, the former laborer regularly helped younger soldiers write letters to their families.
self_review: An unemployed dockworker enlisted for regular pay and spent years helping younger soldiers write to their families.
source_pattern: The supplied Sierra Leone TRC findings link some army recruitment to unemployment and monthly wages.
fictional_changes: Dock work, promotion to sergeant, and help with letters are plausible inventions, not details of a documented recruit.
